scope: Local diagnostic on provided-model training data; not unseen-data or Kaggle performance

clean_timing.scope: Two warm-up batches excluded; includes loader iteration, normalization to [0,1], host/device copies and prediction; excludes initial image decode and metric/file writing

timing_scope: Per-attack warm-up excluded; includes loader/transfers, attack generation, float and quantized inference, bound statistics and example selection; excludes image cache loading and metric/file writing
pgd_selection: Best per sample across clean input, all iterates and restarts: misclassification first, then cross entropy. No FGSM candidate inclusion.
